newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Innovative Int'l unit sets HK$200 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Innovative Int'l unit sets HK$200 mln loan.

text.p: Innovative International (HK) Ltd's HK$200 financing facility was launched on Friday, arranger BNP Hong Kong said.
The deal is guaranteed by Innovative International (Holdings) Ltd.
The facility has a final maturity of three years with no put or call options. It comprises two tranches.
Tranche A is a HK$120 million term loan facility. The repayment of the amortising loan is in four equal semiannual instalments with a grace period of 18 months. Its average life is 2.55 years.
Tranche B is a HK$80 million revolving credit.
Both tranches pay 125 basis points over Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate.
Fees are 75 basis points for lead managers committing HK$40 million and 60 basis points for managers committing HK$20 million.
Proceeds are to be used for refinancing previous loans and investment projects in China.
